description:
The figure will present a three-panel academic framework diagram, flowing horizontally from left to right, maintaining consistent spacing between panels and components for a clean, modular look. The overall canvas background is pure white. Each of the three main panels will have a distinct, slightly recessed appearance with a *very subtle, almost white, cool gray* background and gently rounded corners with a moderate radius. All text will be in a clean, professional sans-serif font, clearly readable, with mathematical variables rendered in an italicized serif style (LaTeX-like).

**Panel 1: 'Schema Compilation'**
